related.title: El Capitan MI300A 超級電腦
related.why: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。
related.whyEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.transfer: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。
related.transferEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.difference: 本課針對Grace–Blackwell、機架 NVLink 與液冷；El Capitan MI300A 超級電腦改以APU 共享 HBM 與 Slingshot 系統架構為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on grace-blackwell, rack nvlink and liquid cooling; El Capitan MI300A supercomputer centers on apu shared hbm and slingshot systems, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Grace與Blackwell記憶與MI300A共享HBM，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到El Capitan MI300A 超級電腦，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以服務邊界與復原為起點，設計一項能區分「Grace–Blackwell、機架 NVLink 與液冷」與「APU 共享 HBM 與 Slingshot 系統架構」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare grace/blackwell memory with mi300a shared hbm and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to El Capitan MI300A supercomputer, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.
Start from service boundaries and recovery and propose an observation distinguishing grace-blackwell, rack nvlink and liquid cooling from apu shared hbm and slingshot systems, including uncertainty.

以服務邊界與復原為起點，設計一項能區分「Grace–Blackwell、機架 NVLink 與液冷」與「異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare grace/blackwell memory with gh200 coherent memory and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from service boundaries and recovery and propose an observation distinguishing grace-blackwell, rack nvlink and liquid cooling from heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links, including uncertainty.
